faqs.question: What is Zero Depreciation cover?
faqs.answer: Zero Depreciation means Aegis covers the entire cost of replacing plastic, rubber, and glass parts without subtracting age-based wear and tear values from your claim.

faqs.question: Is roadside towing covered?
faqs.answer: Yes! Both plans include roadside emergency towing. Our Premium plan provides unlimited towing to the nearest empanelled corporate garage.
